name: Troika Consulting
deliverable: Rapid triad peer consulting using back-turned active listening protocols

steps.text: Form triads; the client states the challenge.
Consultants ask facts only; hold all advice.
Client turns their back while the consultants discuss for five minutes.
Client names what landed, then one next step; rotate.

failure: The client turns around to defend decisions, so consultants manage reactions instead of exploring the problem.
intervention: Tell the client: turn back and stay silent; every word you add narrows what they will say.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
